name: Inamori Arles
source:
Birth year: 2038

Main character of episode 1
Hospitalized since the day she was born, Arles is merely a naive girl when it comes to the outer world. As a result, after her discharge, [url=/c92698]her mother[/url] decided to take her to [url=/c92641]Subaru[/url]'s secret village to live with [url=/c92637]Rei[/url], in hope of showing the little girl various sides of daily life.
Later on in the story, [spoiler]Arles eloped with [url=/c92637]Rei[/url], possessing the same desire of seeing the world outside of the village.[/spoiler]
Loves bird and spending time idly.

Main character of episode 2
A 15-year-old girl member of the URH, along with [url=/c92637]Rei[/url], [spoiler]with her ability to show past events through physical devices (such as a projector) playing a vital role.[/spoiler]
